items.title: Lesson 1: The Alphabet
items.description: This lesson includes the alphabet, consonants and vowels, special combinations of syllables, and vocabulary related to the alphabet.

supplements.title: Pronunciation Workshop
supplements.note: Audio practice for Spanish vowels and high-value alphabet sound patterns.

supplements.title: Numbers
supplements.note: Number practice that supports early introductions and identity work.

items.title: Lesson 2: Greetings and Farewells
items.description: This lesson includes the vocabulary of greetings and farewells, and basic dialogues related to the topic.

supplements.title: Partner Conversations: Greetings
supplements.note: Modeled and scaffolded Victor/Spencer greeting exchanges.

items.title: Lesson 3: The Classroom
items.description: This lesson includes vocabulary and expressions used in the classroom, and information to identify people and things.

supplements.title: Partner Conversations: Classroom
supplements.note: Partner rounds using classroom words and simple identification patterns.

items.title: Review: Greetings, Farewells and The Classroom
items.description: Greetings, Farewells and The Classroom

items.title: Quiz: Lessons 2 and 3
items.description: This quiz evaluates lesson 2 greetings and farewells, lesson 3 the classroom.

items.title: Lesson 4: Subject Pronouns
items.description: This lesson includes personal pronouns, the verb llamarse, general information related to possessive adjectives and family, and a reading and writing exercise.

supplements.title: Family Expansion
supplements.note: Family and identity vocabulary that extends the HSA Lesson 4 family thread.

supplements.title: Writing
supplements.note: Short written self-introduction work using pronouns, names, and family.

items.title: Review: Lessons 1-4
items.description: The Alphabet, Greetings and Farewells, The Classroom and Subject Pronouns.

supplements.title: Speaking Self-Introduction
supplements.note: Spoken self-introduction practice before the Unit 1 project.

supplements.title: Short Reading + Website Audio
supplements.note: A short identity-themed reading with companion audio.

items.title: Exam: Lessons 1-4
items.description: This exam evaluates lesson 1 the alphabet, lesson 2 greetings and farewells, lesson 3 the classroom, and lesson 4 subject pronouns.

supplements.title: Asi Soy Yo Project
supplements.note: Culminating Unit 1 identity project after HSA Lessons 1-4 are reviewed.

items.title: Lesson 5: Origin and Nationality
items.description: This lesson includes the verb ser and its conjugation; vocabulary for different countries and nationalities.

items.title: Lesson 6: Descriptions and Colors
items.description: This lesson includes the verb ser, a list of common adjectives, concordance of gender and number of adjectives in Spanish, and a list of colors.

items.title: Review: Origin, Nationalities, Descriptions and Colors
items.description: Origin and Nationalities and To Be: Descriptions and Colors

items.title: Quiz: Lessons 5 and 6
items.description: This quiz evaluates lesson 5 the verb ser and origin and nationalities, lesson 6 the verb ser and descriptions.

items.title: Lesson 7: Professions and Occupations
items.description: This lesson is about professions and occupations.

items.title: Lesson 8: There Is and There Are
items.description: This lesson includes the impersonal form of haber, there is/there are, specific examples, and vocabulary of the parts of a house.

items.title: Review: Lessons 5-8
items.description: Origin and Nationalities, To Be: Descriptions and Colors, Professions and Occupations and There is/are (Impersonal).

items.title: Exam: Lessons 5-8
items.description: This exam evaluates lesson 5 the verb ser, origin and nationalities, lesson 6 the verb ser and description, lesson 7 professions and occupations, and lesson 8 there is/there are (impersonal).

items.title: Lesson 9: Cardinal Numbers
items.description: This lesson includes the correct writing and pronunciation of cardinal numbers in Spanish; the verb costar used with prices, and specific examples and practice.

items.title: Lesson 10: The Time and Events
items.description: This lesson includes the verb ser used to ask about the hour or the time of an event; it also includes a list of the most common events.

items.title: Review: Cardinal Numbers, Time and Events
items.description: Cardinal Numbers and The Time and Events

items.title: Quiz: Lessons 9 and 10
items.description: This quiz evaluates lesson 9 cardinal numbers, and lesson 10 the time and events.

items.title: Lesson 11: Date and Seasons
items.description: This lesson includes the verb ser used to ask about the date; it also includes a list of days of the week, months of the year and seasons.

items.title: Lesson 12: Conditions and States
items.description: This lesson includes the verb estar and its conjugation, a list of adjectives used with this verb, and specific examples and practice.

items.title: Review: Lessons 9-12
items.description: Cardinal Numbers, The Time and Events, The Date and Seasons and Conditions and States.

items.title: Exam: Lessons 9-12
items.description: This exam evaluates lesson 9 cardinal numbers, lesson 10 the time and events, lesson 11 the date and seasons, and lesson 12 the verb estar, conditions and states.

items.title: Lesson 13: Places and Locations
items.description: This lesson includes the verb estar, a list of prepositions used with this verb and vocabulary of places; it also includes a reading and writing exercise.

items.title: Lesson 14: Verb To Want
items.description: This lesson includes the verb querer, its conjugation and uses, and a list of vegetables.

items.title: Review: Places, Querer and Vegetables
items.description: Places and Locations and Verb To Want and Vegetables

items.title: Quiz: Lessons 13 and 14
items.description: This quiz evaluates lesson 13 the verb estar places and location, and lesson 14 the verb querer and vegetables.

items.description: Lessons from 1 to 14

items.title: Exam: Lessons 1-14
